notes: Official simplified method: A_facade=b+0.7*A_C_Ref with b=50/25/5 m2 for 0/1/2 attached neighbours. The report describes the procedure as suitable for plausibility control and rough assessment of large housing portfolios.

TABULA A_C_Ref is conditioned reference floor area. Exact semantic identity with KEOP23 is not proven. P95 therefore preserves A_C_Ref proxy as [heated_floor_area,total_floor_area] rather than using a point equality.
KEOP23 synthetic geometry has no attached-neighbour field and some FAMILY_HOUSE source notes include family/row-house semantics. P95 preserves all TABULA classes 0/1/2 as a set.
Using KEOP heated floor as the closest single A_C_Ref proxy and varying only neighbour class, only 2 of 23 P85 bbox facade values overlap the TABULA estimator set. The bbox route is not certified.
Even after widening A_C_Ref to [heated,total] floor area and neighbour class to 0..2, only 11 of 23 bbox facade proxies overlap. This remains insufficient for canonical facade use.

Source reports 40% of buildings within +/-0.1 and 80% within +/-0.3 for TOTAL envelope actual/estimated relation, with no relevant systematic deviation. P95 explicitly forbids relabelling +/-0.3 as a facade-specific uncertainty interval.

The bbox facade route failed independent validation and is removed from the canonical reference-programme facade path. Historical P85 bbox data remain for diagnostics/provenance. No PASS is minted for the bbox proxy.

All 14 WBL-period x P21-building-group strata receive gross facade intervals from candidate-type TABULA estimator sets. P92 opening-share calibration is then applied to this new canonical gross facade surface.

Global opening proxy is 4.88501016703..26.508888888889 m2/dwelling and net-wall proxy is 29.637374678663..212.071111111111 m2/dwelling. The registry lower/upper fields span the union only; exact component bounds are preserved in the processed surface.
Reference-programme facade/opening/net-wall, top-envelope and bottom-envelope geometry are now materialized without the failed bbox route. Realized/project geometry remains separately evidence-gated.

P95 supersedes the bbox facade route and removes BBOX_RECTANGULARIZATION_VALIDATION_REQUIRED from the current reference-programme residual set. Independent thermal-state, location, supply-temperature and evidence residuals remain.
